fusions.name: Rain of Stingers
fusions.desc: Looses 3 raindrops at once, spread apart. Each one deals 8 damage, with a 60% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tireless Drip
fusions.desc: Spits venomed water at the first enemy it meets. It deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed Comb
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. A swarm of droplets fights beside you for 12 seconds and deals 3 damage to an enemy every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dew-Carrier
fusions.desc: A bonded Dew Carrier fights beside you. Every second it deals 3 damage to an enemy within 5 tiles, and anything it hits moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
